successors.name: Government General of Warsaw
successors.text: the German-established Government General of Warsaw (1915)

ledger.x: 1815, 9 June: the Final Act of the Congress of Vienna makes "most of the Duchy of Warsaw, except the provinces held by Austria and Prussia" an "independent Kingdom of Poland" with Tsar Alexander I as king (128,500 km2 and about 3.3 million people at creation; the Tsar agreed the compromise on 24 October 1815 and the…
1830, 29 November: the November Uprising begins; the Sejm deposed Nicholas I in January 1831 and the Polish National Government replaced the Kingdom's administration during the war.
1831: the November Uprising is crushed and the Kingdom is reorganised by the Organic Statute of 1832 ("issued by the Emperor in 1832").
1863-1865: the January Uprising "was crushed within about two years"; afterwards the governorates were divided (1867) and the name Kingdom of Poland was replaced by Vistula Land.
1874: the office of viceroy is abolished and the territory is governed by the Governor-General of Warsaw; the official name Vistula Land replaced Kingdom of Poland "after the 1863 uprising".
1912: "The 1912 reform created a new governorate", Kholm (Chelm), from parts of the Sedlets and Lublin governorates, taken out of the Kingdom.
1915, 19 September: the Russian withdrawal in the Great Retreat; the Central Powers occupy the Kingdom, which the German-established Government General of Warsaw succeeds.
1915, September: the Lublin area becomes the Military Government of Lublin.
1915: "The Kingdom of Poland effectively came to an end with the Great Retreat of Russian forces in 1915".

wars.name: November Uprising
wars.outcome: The uprising begins 29 November 1830, Nicholas I is deposed by the Sejm in January 1831 and the Kingdom is reorganised by the Organic Statute of 1832.

wars.name: January Uprising
wars.outcome: The uprising begins 23 January 1863 and is crushed within about two years; the name Vistula Land replaces Kingdom of Poland.

wars.name: Great Retreat (Russia)
wars.outcome: The Russian withdrawal of 19 September 1915 ends the Kingdom.
